newsitem.title: CANADA: Hydro-Quebec sets C$400 million bond due 2002.
newsitem.headline: Hydro-Quebec sets C$400 million bond due 2002.

text.p: Hydro-Quebec set a C$400 million 5.75 percent bond due February 15, 2002 in financial markets, said lead manager Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion.
The bond was priced at C$99.22 with a yield of 5.93 percent, 9.3 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.5 percent bond due April, 2002.
The new issue also contains a feature which allows the holder to exchange it at maturity for the Hydro-Quebec 7.0 percent bond due February 15, 2007.
The holder of the new issue will be able to exchange the bond between December 10, 2001 and January 15, 2002.
